settings.text: Omakase Enterprises LLP ("Simply Kids", "we", "us") is committed to protecting the privacy of everyone who visits simplykids.in, including children whose parents or guardians shop with us on their behalf.

settings.heading: What we collect
settings.text: Order and contact details you provide at checkout (name, address, phone, email); browsing data via cookies and analytics; and, where you choose to share it, your child's first name and age for personalisation features such as the Community gallery or age-based product recommendations.

settings.heading: Children's data
settings.text: Simply Kids products are for children aged 4–12, but our website and accounts are operated by parents/guardians. We do not knowingly collect personal data directly from children without verified parental consent, and any child-related information (like a first name and age submitted to "Be the Pride") is provided by the parent or guardian at their discretion, for the sole purpose of that feature.

settings.heading: How we use your data
settings.text: To process and ship orders, respond to queries, personalise the shopping experience, and — only with consent via cookie preferences — for marketing and analytics.

settings.heading: Your rights
settings.text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by writing to support@simplykids.in.
